installPipeline: runtime/spike/install-pipeline.js (digest → cache/blobs/<sha256> → verify → untar → manifest validate → integrity ledger → stage → read-back verify → promote → receipt)
sha256: pure-JS (runtime/spike/sha256.js), cross-checked against node:crypto over 10 vectors incl. block boundaries; the spike host exposes no digest primitive
packageFormat: uncompressed POSIX ustar (runtime/spike/tar-mini.js), read back by system tar — gzip transport coding deferred to the fetch-based installer
tamperCase: second package with drifting entry bytes rejected by the trust record before unpack; installed tree byte-identical; no receipt written for the rejected transaction
manifestSchemaValidation: strict minimal validator in install-pipeline.js (unknown fields fail loud per contract manifest.schema.json additionalProperties:false)
